```{r init, include=FALSE}
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- PIRNA_COMPARE_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- PIRNA_COMPARE_TAB
prepare_module_outputs(
  OUTPUT_FIG_DIR,
  OUTPUT_TAB_DIR,
  c(
    "01_composition",
"02_annotation_trends",
"03_length_distribution",
"04_sample_qc",
"05_top_annotations",
"06_sequence_pattern",
"07_de/00_config",
"07_de/01_annotation",
"07_de/02_sequence",
"08_validation/01_abundance",
"08_validation/02_sequence_signature",
"08_validation/03_cluster_pingpong_feasibility"
  )
)
activate_mii_context(environment())
```

```{r build-pirna-inputs, include=FALSE}
pirna_sample_total <- sample_comp_view %>%
  filter(as.character(MainCategory) == "piRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

pirna_group_total <- pirna_sample_total %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("MainCategory") %>%
  left_join(group_clean_reads_tbl, by = "Group") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

pirna_detail <- output_all %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "piRNA", !is.na(PrimaryAnnotation), PrimaryAnnotation != "", PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

pirna_annotation_sample <- pirna_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

pirna_annotation_group <- pirna_annotation_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm("PrimaryAnnotation") %>%
  left_join(
    pirna_annotation_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("PrimaryAnnotation") %>%
      select(Group, PrimaryAnnotation, Percent),
    by = c("Group", "PrimaryAnnotation")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Percent = replace_na(Percent, 0))

pirna_levels <- pirna_annotation_group %>%
  group_by(PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(PrimaryAnnotation)

if (length(pirna_levels) == 0) {
  pirna_levels <- unique(as.character(pirna_annotation_group$PrimaryAnnotation))
}

pirna_palette <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(max(1, length(pirna_levels)), palette = "Set 3"), pirna_levels)
pirna_annotation_trend <- pirna_annotation_group %>%
  filter(PrimaryAnnotation %in% pirna_levels) %>%
  transmute(Group, TrendCategory = PrimaryAnnotation, Reads, Percent)

pirna_length_group <- group_length_view %>%
  filter(MainCategory == "piRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

pirna_sample_detection <- pirna_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    DetectedpiRNAs = n_distinct(PrimaryAnnotation),
    piRNAReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    piRNAReadFraction = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * piRNAReads / CleanReads, 0),
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)
  )

pirna_feature_matrix <- build_feature_count_matrix(
  pirna_detail,
  feature_col = "PrimaryAnnotation",
  sample_order = as.character(sample_info$Sample),
  feature_order = pirna_levels,
  min_total = 0
)

pirna_correlation_tbl <- tibble()
if (nrow(pirna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2 && ncol(pirna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2) {
  pirna_cor <- cor(log2(pirna_feature_matrix$matrix + 1), method = "pearson")
  pirna_cor_order <- rownames(pirna_cor)
  if (nrow(pirna_cor) > 1) {
    pirna_cor_order <- rownames(pirna_cor)[hclust(as.dist(1 - pirna_cor), method = "complete")$order]
  }
  pirna_correlation_tbl <- expand.grid(sample_x = pirna_cor_order, sample_y = pirna_cor_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  pirna_correlation_tbl$correlation <- as.vector(pirna_cor[pirna_cor_order, pirna_cor_order])
}

pirna_top_annotations <- pirna_annotation_group %>%
  filter(RPM > 0 | Reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = RPM, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

pirna_top_annotations_overall <- pirna_annotation_group %>%
  group_by(PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), PrimaryAnnotation)
```

```{r pirna-qc, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(pirna_correlation_tbl) > 0) {
  pirna_cor_values <- pirna_correlation_tbl$correlation[is.finite(pirna_correlation_tbl$correlation)]
  pirna_cor_min <- if (length(pirna_cor_values) > 0) min(pirna_cor_values) else 0
  if (!is.finite(pirna_cor_min) || pirna_cor_min >= 1) pirna_cor_min <- 0.95
  pirna_cor_plot <- ggplot(pirna_correlation_tbl, aes(sample_x, sample_y, fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.finite(correlation), sprintf("%.2f", correlation), "")), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = mii_diverging_palette,
      limits = c(pirna_cor_min, 1),
      na.value = mii_neutral_line
    ) +
    labs(title = "Sample correlation from piRNA-annotated features", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Pearson r") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  save_plot_nested(
    pirna_cor_plot,
    "04_sample_qc",
    "pirna_sample_correlation_heatmap.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 6.5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r pirna-sequence-pattern, include=FALSE}
pirna_sequence_pattern <- pirna_detail %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "", nchar(Sequence) >= 3) %>%
  mutate(
    SequenceClean = toupper(gsub("U", "T", Sequence)),
    FirstBase = substr(SequenceClean, 1, 1),
    FivePrimeTriplet = substr(SequenceClean, 1, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(str_detect(FirstBase, "^[ACGT]$"), str_detect(FivePrimeTriplet, "^[ACGT]{3}$"))

pirna_first_base_sample <- pirna_sequence_pattern %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, FirstBase) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), SequenceCount = n_distinct(SequenceClean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(ReadPercent = group_percent(Reads), SequencePercent = group_percent(SequenceCount)) %>%
  ungroup()

pirna_first_base_group <- pirna_first_base_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("FirstBase", percent_col = "ReadPercent") %>%
  select(Group, FirstBase, Reads, ReadPercent = Percent) %>%
  left_join(
    pirna_first_base_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("FirstBase", percent_col = "SequencePercent", reads_col = "SequenceCount") %>%
      select(Group, FirstBase, SequenceCount = Reads, SequencePercent = Percent),
    by = c("Group", "FirstBase")
  )

pirna_triplet_sample <- pirna_sequence_pattern %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, FivePrimeTriplet) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), SequenceCount = n_distinct(SequenceClean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(ReadPercent = group_percent(Reads), SequencePercent = group_percent(SequenceCount)) %>%
  ungroup()

pirna_triplet_group <- pirna_triplet_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("FivePrimeTriplet", percent_col = "ReadPercent") %>%
  select(Group, FivePrimeTriplet, Reads, ReadPercent = Percent) %>%
  left_join(
    pirna_triplet_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("FivePrimeTriplet", percent_col = "SequencePercent", reads_col = "SequenceCount") %>%
      select(Group, FivePrimeTriplet, SequenceCount = Reads, SequencePercent = Percent),
    by = c("Group", "FivePrimeTriplet")
  )

if (nrow(pirna_first_base_group) > 0) {
  base_palette <- c(A = mii_green, C = mii_blue, G = mii_orange, T = mii_red)
  first_base_plot <- ggplot(
    pirna_first_base_group %>% mutate(FirstBase = factor(FirstBase, levels = c("A", "C", "G", "T"))),
    aes(x = Group, y = ReadPercent, fill = FirstBase)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = base_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Group",
      y = "Percent of piRNA-annotated reads",
      title = "piRNA 5-prime first-base composition",
      fill = "Base"
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  save_plot_nested(
    first_base_plot,
    "06_sequence_pattern",
    "pirna_first_base_read_percent.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
} else {
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_note("piRNA-annotated sequence pattern", "No piRNA-annotated sequences were available for first-base composition."),
    "06_sequence_pattern",
    "pirna_first_base_read_percent.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

top_triplets <- pirna_triplet_group %>%
  group_by(FivePrimeTriplet) %>%
  summarise(TotalReadPercent = sum(ReadPercent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalReadPercent), FivePrimeTriplet) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(FivePrimeTriplet)

if (length(top_triplets) > 0) {
  triplet_plot_df <- pirna_triplet_group %>%
    filter(FivePrimeTriplet %in% top_triplets) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
      FivePrimeTriplet = factor(FivePrimeTriplet, levels = rev(top_triplets))
    )

  triplet_plot <- ggplot(triplet_plot_df, aes(x = FivePrimeTriplet, y = ReadPercent, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.78), width = 0.72) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of piRNA-annotated reads",
      title = "Top piRNA 5-prime triplets across groups"
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())

  save_plot_nested(
    triplet_plot,
    "06_sequence_pattern",
    "pirna_top_5prime_triplets.pdf",
    width = 9.5,
    height = 6.6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
} else {
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_note("piRNA 5-prime triplets", "No piRNA triplet pattern could be calculated."),
    "06_sequence_pattern",
    "pirna_top_5prime_triplets.pdf",
    width = 8,
    height = 5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

write_csv_safe(pirna_group_total, "pirna_group_total.csv")
write_csv_safe(pirna_annotation_group, "pirna_annotation_group.csv")

write_csv_safe(pirna_first_base_group, "pirna_first_base_group.csv")
write_csv_safe(pirna_triplet_group, "pirna_5prime_triplet_group.csv")
```

```{r pirna-validation-pirna-abundance, include=FALSE}
pirna_fraction_by_sample <- sample_comp_view %>%
  mutate(MainCategory = as.character(MainCategory)) %>%
  filter(MainCategory == "piRNA") %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group), piRNA_Reads = Reads, piRNA_Percent = Percent) %>%
  right_join(sample_qc_table %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group), CleanReads), by = c("Sample", "Group")) %>%
  mutate(
    piRNA_Reads = replace_na(piRNA_Reads, 0),
    piRNA_Percent = replace_na(piRNA_Percent, 0),
    low_abundance_flag = piRNA_Reads < 1000 | piRNA_Percent < 0.1,
    interpretation = if_else(
      low_abundance_flag,
      "Low abundance; validate before interpreting piRNA biology.",
      "Abundance is sufficient for basic composition review."
    )
  )

write_csv_safe(pirna_fraction_by_sample, "08_validation/01_abundance/pirna_abundance_by_sample.csv")

pi_abundance_plot <- ggplot(pirna_fraction_by_sample, aes(x = Sample, y = piRNA_Percent, fill = low_abundance_flag)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = mii_red, `FALSE` = mii_green), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "piRNA fraction by sample", x = NULL, y = "Percent of clean reads", fill = "Low abundance") +
  mii_theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
save_plot_nested(pi_abundance_plot, "08_validation/01_abundance", "pirna_fraction_by_sample.pdf", width = 9, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
```

```{r pirna-validation-sequence-signature, include=FALSE}
pirna_rows <- output_all %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "piRNA", !is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
  mutate(
    first_base = substr(Sequence, 1, 1),
    tenth_base = if_else(nchar(Sequence) >= 10, substr(Sequence, 10, 10), NA_character_),
    is_1U = first_base %in% c("T", "U"),
    is_10A = tenth_base == "A"
  )

pirna_sequence_signature <- pirna_rows %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sequence_n = n_distinct(Sequence),
    sample_n = n_distinct(Sample),
    median_length = median(Length, na.rm = TRUE),
    one_U_read_fraction = if_else(total_reads > 0, sum(Reads[is_1U], na.rm = TRUE) / total_reads, 0),
    ten_A_read_fraction = if_else(total_reads > 0, sum(Reads[is_10A], na.rm = TRUE) / total_reads, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_grade = case_when(
      total_reads < 1000 ~ "low_abundance",
      one_U_read_fraction >= 0.45 | ten_A_read_fraction >= 0.25 ~ "signature_supportive",
      TRUE ~ "weak_signature"
    ),
    interpretation = case_when(
      evidence_grade == "signature_supportive" ~ "Basic piRNA sequence signature is supportive.",
      evidence_grade == "low_abundance" ~ "Low piRNA abundance limits signature interpretation.",
      TRUE ~ "1U/10A signature is weak; treat as annotation-only evidence."
    )
  )

pirna_base_position <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  pirna_rows %>% select(Sequence, Reads) %>% distinct(),
  Position = c(1L, 10L)
) %>%
  mutate(Base = if_else(nchar(Sequence) >= Position, substr(Sequence, Position, Position), NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Base)) %>%
  group_by(Position, Base) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Position) %>%
  mutate(Fraction = Reads / sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

pirna_length_distribution <- pirna_rows %>%
  group_by(Length) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), SequenceN = n_distinct(Sequence), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Length)

write_csv_safe(pirna_sequence_signature, "08_validation/02_sequence_signature/pirna_1U_10A_signature_summary.csv")
write_csv_safe(pirna_base_position, "08_validation/02_sequence_signature/pirna_position_1_10_base_fraction.csv")
write_csv_safe(pirna_length_distribution, "08_validation/02_sequence_signature/pirna_length_distribution.csv")

if (nrow(pirna_base_position) > 0) {
  base_plot <- ggplot(pirna_base_position, aes(x = Base, y = Fraction, fill = Base)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    facet_wrap(~ Position, labeller = labeller(Position = c(`1` = "Position 1", `10` = "Position 10"))) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(A = mii_green, C = mii_blue, G = mii_orange, T = mii_red, U = mii_red), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "piRNA 1U / 10A signature proxy", x = NULL, y = "Read fraction", fill = NULL) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  save_plot_nested(base_plot, "08_validation/02_sequence_signature", "pirna_1U_10A_signature_proxy.pdf", width = 8, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}

if (nrow(pirna_length_distribution) > 0) {
  length_plot <- ggplot(pirna_length_distribution, aes(x = Length, y = Reads)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = mii_purple) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = "piRNA length distribution", x = "Length", y = "Reads") +
    mii_theme_bw()
  save_plot_nested(length_plot, "08_validation/02_sequence_signature", "pirna_length_distribution.pdf", width = 8, height = 5.5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
} else {
  save_plot_nested(plot_note("piRNA validation", "No piRNA rows were available."), "08_validation/02_sequence_signature", "pirna_signature_note.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 5, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}
```

```{r pirna-validation-cluster-pingpong-feasibility, include=FALSE}
alignment_files <- list.files(SPORTS_SAMPLE_ROOT, pattern = "[.](bam|sam)$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
total_pirna_reads <- sum(pirna_fraction_by_sample$piRNA_Reads, na.rm = TRUE)

cluster_pingpong_feasibility <- tibble(
  analysis = c("piRNA cluster analysis", "ping-pong signature"),
  status = c(
    if_else(length(alignment_files) > 0 && total_pirna_reads >= 10000, "ready_for_coordinate_analysis", "skipped"),
    if_else(length(alignment_files) > 0 && total_pirna_reads >= 10000, "ready_for_coordinate_analysis", "skipped")
  ),
  reason = c(
    if_else(length(alignment_files) > 0, "Alignment files detected.", "No genome-coordinate BAM/SAM files detected."),
    if_else(total_pirna_reads >= 10000, "piRNA-annotated read threshold met.", "piRNA-annotated reads are too low for stable ping-pong review.")
  ),
  next_requirement = c(
    "Use genome-coordinate BAM plus piRNA cluster annotation.",
    "Use strand-aware genome coordinates and 5' overlap statistics."
  )
)
write_csv_safe(cluster_pingpong_feasibility, "08_validation/03_cluster_pingpong_feasibility/pirna_cluster_pingpong_feasibility.csv")

save_plot_nested(
  plot_note(
    "piRNA cluster / ping-pong feasibility",
    "Cluster and ping-pong analyses are enabled only with genome-coordinate BAM/SAM and adequate piRNA abundance."
  ),
  "08_validation/03_cluster_pingpong_feasibility",
  "pirna_cluster_pingpong_skipped_reason.pdf",
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

piRNA validation completed.
